semiconductor_relevance: Medium — while primarily a research institution, their advancements in terahertz wave technology and SiC substrates have implications for semiconductor applications.
summary: Kyushu University Kato Laboratory is focused on advancing terahertz wave technology, which is crucial for next-generation communication systems. Their research includes the development of high-power terahertz wave sources using SiC substrates, enhancing performance and reliability in communication modules.
capabilities: SiC substrate technology for thermal management
